items.reason: Covers POST /order-bids/instant, the controller→Xzj27→Xdg64 call chain, synchronous single-transaction processing without Kafka, and the response ID being the OrderBid ID, with correct line references.

Names all three entities (Xdg64 PENDING_PAYMENT, Xhm58, Xhx14 PENDING) in the right order with references; the amount, quantity and address-copy details are thin but the partial-credit condition is not triggered.
Explains assignOrder→MATCHED, the extra updateStatus(MATCHED) and flush, and the seller warehouse ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER change, with references (Xdg64CommandService:279-294, Xzz58:58-61).

Card (PAID only on success, otherwise PENDING but purchase still succeeds) and general (PAID) are correct; bank transfer is wrongly described as succeeding in PENDING instead of failing and rolling back, so capped at 0.5.

States SOLD is set without a transition check, that orderBid is null so the sale bid is found via findByOrderId, and that exceptions are swallowed, with references (Xbf54CommandService:383-425, Xgg74:73-75).
Gives buyer and seller messages, SHOPPING/BID, sending before SOLD, DB save, and WebSocket push only when the Redis key exists, with references.

States the OrderBid is created after the order with MATCHED and isInstantPurchase=true (Xzj27CommandService:189-207); bid price and links are not spelled out but the partial-credit condition is not triggered.

Gives final status PENDING_PAYMENT, notes isWarehouseStorage is unused and no Xnn94 is created, and contrasts with the Kafka/processPaymentAndShipment path; isInstantSale is not mentioned but the partial-credit condition is not triggered.

PATCH /shipments/order/{shipmentId}/status → updateTrackingInfo 경로와 의도된 순서(검증→배송 IN_TRANSIT 직접 대입→주문 IN_TRANSIT→구매자 출발 알림→판매 SOLD·판매자 알림→창고 SOLD→입찰 COMPLETED)를 모두 맞혔고, 근거 줄(33-49, 238-303, Xhx14.java:41-45)도 맞다.

PREPARING→IN_TRANSIT 전이가 불가하고 SHIPMENT_STARTED로 바꾸는 코드가 없다는 점, Xxc76StatusException이 SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND로 감싸진다는 점, S001/404 응답, @Transactional 롤백으로 저장·알림이 없다는 점을 근거와 함께 제시했다. 창고 주문 실패도 언급했다(즉시 구매 실패는 명시하지 않았다).
cron 0 0 */6 * * *, updateShipmentStatusesJob, 리더 조건(IN_TRANSIT/OUT_FOR_DELIVERY이고 trackingNumber가 not null), chunk 50을 근거 줄과 함께 맞혔다.
실제 processor로 Xth19Processor를 지목했고 마지막 행 5번째 td를 읽는다는 점을 맞혔다. 미사용 @Bean 람다와 호출처 없는 updateShipmentStatuses도 짚었고, 매핑(배송완료/배송출발/그 외)과 현재 상태와 같을 때의 no-op도 근거와 함께 맞혔다.
DELIVERED→completeOrder(OrderBid 조회, 주문 COMPLETED, updateSaleStatusToSold와 판매자 알림, 구매자 completeOrder 알림)→notifyShipmentCompleted 순서와 구매자 알림 2건을 근거와 함께 맞혔다. 알림 타입(SHOPPING/BID)은 언급하지 않았다.
updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted는 289에서만 호출되고 그 경로는 실패한다는 점, completeOrder에는 입찰 변경이 없어 입찰이 MATCHED로 남는다는 점을 근거와 함께 맞혔다.
(a) PREPARING→COMPLETED가 불가해 ORDER_NOT_FOUND_FOR_SHIPMENT로 실패한다는 점, (b) PENDING_PAYMENT→COMPLETED로 완료되고 판매가 이미 SOLD라 판매 처리를 건너뛰어 구매자 알림 2건만 간다는 점을 근거(Xbf54:404, Xgg74Status:25)와 함께 맞혔다.

PATCH /shipments/order/{shipmentId}/status → updateTrackingInfo, and all 7 steps are correct: validation, direct IN_TRANSIT assignment, order IN_TRANSIT, buyer notification, sale SOLD with seller notification, warehouse SOLD, bids COMPLETED. Citations are present (C:33-34, S:239-303, H:41-45).

PREPARING→IN_TRANSIT is not allowed (OS:26,28; O:113-121), so Xxc76StatusException is thrown and wrapped as SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND. Response is S001/404, the whole transaction rolls back with no notification, and instant-purchase orders fail the same way. Citations are accurate.
Xpb98BatchScheduler runs updateShipmentStatusesJob on cron 0 0 */6 * * *. Reader selects IN_TRANSIT/OUT_FOR_DELIVERY with a tracking number, page size 50. Citations: Scheduler:34-40, J:51, J:95.

Identifies the step's processor as new Xth19Processor (J:69-73): Playwright reads the 5th cell of the last row. Notes the shipmentItemProcessor lambda and updateShipmentStatuses are unused. Mapping and the same-state no-op are correct (P:220-225, P:101-105).

Order is correct: DELIVERED → completeOrder (OrderBid lookup, COMPLETED, updateSaleStatusToSold, buyer notification) → notifyShipmentCompleted. Buyer gets 2 notifications. Citations are correct (P:108-118, S:190-229, Xkh73:219-229).
States that updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted is called only from the tracking-registration path (S:289), and completeOrder does not touch bids, so they stay MATCHED. Citations are present.

(a) is correct: PREPARING→COMPLETED is not allowed, giving ORDER_NOT_FOUND_FOR_SHIPMENT. For (b), the main claim is that the sale becomes SOLD and the seller gets 1 notification. It misses that the sale was already set to SOLD at payment, so the seller step is skipped and only the 2 buyer notifications go out (the 'if already SOLD' case appears only as a side caveat).

Covers faultTolerant().skip(Exception).skipLimit(50) with remaining items continuing, SkipListener logging, processor wrapping in Xpb98Exception, scheduler printStackTrace, and notifyShipmentCompleted swallowing exceptions. Citations are accurate (J:75-77, 251-287, P:133-146, Scheduler:41-43).

실제 실행 코드를 new Xth19Processor로 지목했다(Playwright로 CJ 조회, 마지막 행 5번째 td). 미사용 @Bean 람다와 호출처 없는 updateShipmentStatuses를 구분했고, 상태 매핑과 동일 상태 스킵도 정확하다.
처리 순서를 맞혔다. DELIVERED→completeOrder(OrderBid 조회, 주문 COMPLETED, updateSaleStatusToSold, 구매자 알림)→notifyShipmentCompleted 순이며, 구매자 알림 2건과 판매 SOLD 조건부 처리를 근거와 함께 제시했다.
입찰 상태가 바뀌지 않는다고 맞혔다. updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted는 289행 운송장 경로에서만 호출되고 completeOrder는 입찰을 건드리지 않아 MATCHED로 남는다는 이유도 근거와 함께 설명했다.
(a)는 PREPARING에서 COMPLETED 전이가 불허되어 ORDER_NOT_FOUND_FOR_SHIPMENT로 실패하고 알림이 없다. (b)는 PENDING_PAYMENT에서 COMPLETED로 완료되고, 판매가 이미 SOLD라 판매자 알림 없이 구매자 2건만 간다. 둘 다 근거와 함께 맞혔다.
faultTolerant().skip(Exception).skipLimit(50)과 SkipListener 로그, Xpb98Exception 래핑, 스케줄러의 printStackTrace, notifyShipmentCompleted 실패를 삼키는 처리를 모두 근거와 함께 설명했다.
